gaps.sentence: He left ___ school at sixteen and went straight into a job.
gaps.explanation: Leave school (finish education) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ last person to leave the building.
gaps.explanation: Ordinals take 'the': the last person, the first time.

gaps.sentence: ___ sun sets much later in summer.
gaps.explanation: 'The sun' — there is only one, so the definite article is used.

gaps.sentence: She works as ___ waitress during the summer holidays.
gaps.explanation: After 'as' and 'work as', jobs take a/an: work as a waitress.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
___ disabled are offered free entry on Sundays.
gaps.explanation: 'The disabled' = disabled people as a group.

gaps.sentence: His mother went to ___ prison to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Visitors go to the building: 'went to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.
